observations.note: This profile deliberately uses the six configure-table values A42.7/B40.9/C37/D20/E54/F26.8. The headline dimension 40.7 x19.7 x42.9 mm differs. No physical revision or vendor interchangeability is established.

The A-F drawing defines overall shaft-top height, case length, housing-top height, case width, total ear length and ear-underside height. It does not dimension shaft XY, slot centers or slot diameters.
The photograph depicts two open mounting pockets on each ear (four total), a top output shaft and one three-conductor cable. Photo topology does not establish pocket size or pitch.
Akizuki identifies seller SKU112534 as a TowerPro MG996R. The seller SKU is separate from this configure-table source profile and does not identify a physical revision.

Box envelopes each use their own minimum-corner placement. The integrated reference model uses the housing minimum corner; the box representations and other datum frames are not automatically registered.

Page2 independently locates four pockets at48.60 x10.00 and the output axis14.25 from the near row, with pocket diameter3.90. It has no case-edge datum or heights. Page1 headline40.7 x19.7 x42.9 differs from the configure-table profile. The source does not establish that the drawing and configure table describe the same physical revision.

assumptions: PREVIEW: this integrated model is for visual layout planning. Amber ears and shaft include unverified geometry; use sourced datum representations separately where available.

Published configure B40.9/D20/C37/A42.7/E54/F26.8 constrain nominal extents only. Symmetric ear extension6.55, ear thickness2, the C-4 shoulder and the cover contour are explicit planning assumptions.

Mount pocket locations and dimensions in the integrated model are PREVIEW unless expressly identified as drawing-relative XY with assumed case registration. They are never promoted to factual dimensions or datums.
The model has no horn, mounting screws, spline teeth, strain relief, cable bend envelope or connector by default.

PREVIEW EXIT APPROX: place one three-conductor outlet marker on the shaft-near short face at X0/Y(D/2)/Z2, outward -X. Wire diameter1, pitch1.1 and displayed length3 are editable planning values; only the harness/conductor counts are photo observations.
Optional connector geometry10 x8 x4 is an illustrative planning block only and is omitted unless include_connector is explicitly enabled.

PREVIEW MG996R registration: the independent drawing XY pattern is centered on the configure B40.9/D20 case by assumption, giving rowsX-3.85/44.75 withY5/15 and axisX10.4/Y10. The factual drawing output has no vertical extents; model Z placements do not register the drawing to configure F26.8.

parts.label: PREVIEW HOUSING
parts.note: Published configure B40.9 xD20 envelope; PREVIEW shoulder at C-4=33. The 4 mm upper-cover interval is an illustrative choice.

parts.label: PREVIEW NEAR MOUNT EAR
parts.note: Drawing row pitch48.60 and transverse pitch10.00, pocket D3.90. PREVIEW placement in case frame assumes the case is centered between rows; ear thickness2 and slot mouth2 are planning values. The source drawing frame is independently available and has no sourced vertical extents.

parts.label: PREVIEW FAR MOUNT EAR
parts.note: Drawing row pitch48.60 and transverse pitch10.00, pocket D3.90. PREVIEW placement in case frame assumes the case is centered between rows; ear thickness2 and slot mouth2 are planning values. The source drawing frame is independently available and has no sourced vertical extents.

parts.label: PREVIEW UPPER COVER
parts.note: PREVIEW two-lobe cover with main diameter20, secondary diameter8 and center spacing9; nominal top C37. Its outline and 4 mm shoulder interval are planning choices, not a conservative measured turret envelope.

parts.label: PREVIEW OUTPUT SHAFT
parts.note: PREVIEW case-frame center X10.4/Y10 follows drawing axis14.25 from near row plus assumed near-row X-3.85. D6 is illustrative. The configure A-C interval5.7 is used for appearance only; no vertical datum is transferred into the independent drawing output interface.
